text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab League reiterates Arab concern for peace and appreciates Europe's role.
- Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik Al-Hariri says Lebanon and Syria want honourable peace.
- A pro-Israeli south Lebanon army soldier wounded while Israeli attacks continue.
- Israeli minister voices support for Golan settlements.
- The Luxembourg foreign minister arrives in Damascus today.
- Consultations to hold an investment conference in Syria.
- Syrian cabinet discusses work of the economic committee and results of discussions with the Lebanese side.
- The Syrian-Lebanese coordination committee to meet on Monday. Lebanon praises the deals resulting from the Damascus meetings.
- Saudi approves a deal with Syria to fight drug trading.
- The Hebron agreement about to be signed and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu talks about secret articles, important achievments for the settlers and an Israeli control of the West Bank.
- Cool relations between Britain and Israel and London cites Israel responsible for the deadlock of the Middle East peace process.
- Lebanese President Elias Hrawi discusses peace process with a Canadian delegation.
- Jordanian-Israeli talks held to improve ties.
